prompt: Generate a stone arch spanning three cells across one row. Its two pillars occupy only the left and right 128x128 cells; the center cell is walkable. The arch is 160px tall. Deliver transparent art with explicit disjoint support occupancy and a separate overhead span. Deliver each sprite in a 512x448px frame with local projected ground anchor (256,312). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.open-passage: The center cell is open at ground level; the arch overhead must not become a filled base or ground collision.
visualChecks.arch-depth: Foreground/background passage previews show correct occlusion using authored depth pieces; a single Y-sort or flattened-scene cut is insufficient.
visualChecks.support-placement: Both pillar bases land on their declared cells with no support in the center.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
